Top 10

    Source: NMQF Center for Clinical and Social Research analysis of 2021 T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF), Indiana Medicaid. A beneficiary is counted in a condition group with ≥1 inpatient claim or ≥2 other-services claims carrying a qualifying diagnosis code. Prevalence = diagnosed beneficiaries ÷ beneficiaries in the selected population and area. Cells with counts of 1–10 are suppressed (grey); no other floor is applied, so rates in small areas can be unstable. ZIP codes are drawn on 2010 ZCTA boundaries (99.6% of beneficiaries); PO-box ZIPs with no land area appear in rankings but not on the map. Black lines are Indiana Medicaid managed care regions. Condition groups overlap and are not additive. Visualization prepared by NMQF HISS from CCSR analysis tables.
